questions.question: When the price of an item was reduced by 20%, then its sale increased by x%. If there is an increase of 60% in the receipt of the revenue, then the value of x is:
questions.solution:
**Using the following formula****∶** x + y + xy/100 = Effective change

⇒ x – 20 – [20x/100] = 60

⇒ x – [x/5] = 80

⇒ x = 100%

questions.question: The efficiencies of A, B and C are in the ratio 5 : 3 : 8. Working together they can complete a work in 30 days. A and B worked together for 20 days. The remaining work will be completed by C alone in:
questions.solution:
Efficiency of A, B and C are in the ratio 5 : 3 : 8

Total work = (5 + 3 + 8) × 30 = 480

⇒ Total work completed by A and B in 20 days = (5 + 3) × 20 = 160

⇒ Remain work = 480 – 160 = 320

⇒ C will complete the remain work = 320/8 = 40 days

questions.question: If sin θ = 4 cos θ, then what is the value of sin θ cos θ?
questions.solution:
sinθ = 4 cosθ

⇒ tanθ = 4

⇒ tanθ = Perpendicular/Base

By Pythagoras theorem

⇒ H² = P² + B²

⇒ H² = 4² + 1²= 16 + 1 = 17

⇒ H = √17

⇒ sinθ cosθ

⇒ sinθ = Perpendicular/Hypotenuse

⇒ cosθ = Base/Hypotenuse

⇒ sinθ cosθ

⇒ [4/√17] × [1/√17] = 4/17

questions.question: The length of a metallic pipe is 7.56 m. Its external and internal radii are 2.5 cm and 1.5 cm respectively. If 1 cm³ of the metal weight 7.5 g, then the weight of the pipe is : (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
As we know,

Volume of metallic pipe = π(R² – r²)h

⇒ 22/7 × (2.5² – 1.5²) × 7.56 × 100

⇒ 22/7 × 4 × 1 × 756

⇒ 9504 cm³

⇒ 1 cm³ of the metal weight = 7.5g

⇒ 9504 cm³ of the metal weight = (7.5 × 9504)/1000 = 71.28 kg

A trader marks his goods at 40% above the cost price. He sells 70% of the goods at the marked price and the rest, he sells by allowing a 40% discount on the marked price. His percentage profit is:
questions.solution:
Let the total number of goods be 100x.

According to the question

⇒ Selling price of 70% of goods = 100x × (7/10) × (7/5) = 98x

⇒ Selling price of 30% of goods = 100x × (3/10) × (7/5) × (3/5) = 25.2x

⇒ Total selling price of goods = 98x + 25.2x = 123.2x

∴ Profit Percentage = [(123.2x – 100x)/100] × 100 = 23.2%

questions.question: In a circle with center O, ACBO is a parallelogram where C is a point on the minor arc AB. What is the measure of ∠AOB?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ad6422ce2a349d52b204a5bcb1a3eac83dabaebc390af58fa9131b197783728.png] 

As we know, in a parallelogram opposite sides are equal and parallel and opposite angles are also equal.

Suppose ∠ACB = x and ∠AOB = y

∠ACB = ∠AOB [opposite angle]

Reflex ∠AOB = 2x

∵ Angle subtended by an arc on its centre is twice the angle subtended on the circumference.

⇒ 2x + y = 360°

⇒ 2y + y = 360° [∵ x = y(opposite angle)]

⇒ 3y = 360°

⇒ y = 120°

The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 8 : 9. After 9 years, this ratio will become 19 : 21. C is 3 years younger to B. What is the present (in years) of C?
questions.solution:
Let the present ages of A and B be 8x, 9x, respectively.

According to the question

⇒ (8x + 9) / (9x + 9) = 19/21

⇒ x = 6

Present age of B = 9x = 9 × 6 = 54 years

∴ Present age of C = 54 – 3 = 51 years

questions.question: What is the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 10,000 at 14% p.a. for 2(5)/(7) years where the interest is compounded yearly?
questions.solution:
Interest rate for 1 year = 14%

Interest rate for 5/7 years = 14% × [5/7] = 10%

According to the question

⇒ Amount = 10,000 × (114/100) × (114/100) × (110/100) = 14,295.6

⇒ Interest = 14,295.6 – 10,000= 4295.6 (4296 Approx)

questions.question: The average of twelve numbers is 46. The average of the first four numbers is 43 and that of the last five numbers is 49.4. The 5th and the 6th numbers are respectively 4 and 6 more than the 7th number. What is the average of the 5th and 7th numbers?
questions.solution:
Average of 12 numbers = 46

⇒ Sum of all 12 numbers = 12 × 46 = 552

Average of the first 4 numbers = 43

⇒ Sum of first 4 numbers = 4 × 43 = 172

Average of the last five numbers = 49.4

∴ Sum of the last five numbers = 247

Let the 7th number be x.

∴ 5th number will be = x + 4

∴ 6th number will be = x + 6

Sum of 5th, 6th and 7th number = 552 – 172 – 247 = 133

According to the question

⇒ x + x + 4 + x + 6 = 133

⇒ x = 41

⇒ 7th number = 41

⇒ 5th number = x + 4 = 41 + 4 = 45

∴ Average of 7th and 5th number = (41 + 45)/2 = 43

questions.question: In ΔABC with sides 6 cm, 7 cm and 8 cm, the angle bisector of the largest angle divides the opposite side into two segments. What is the length of the shorter segment?
questions.solution:
Suppose AB = 6, BC = 8 and AC = 7

Point D bisect ∠A.

As we know

⇒ DC/BD = 7/6

⇒ (DC/BD) + 1 = (7/6) + 1

⇒ (DC + BD)/BD = 13/6

⇒ 8/BD = 13/6

⇒ BD = 48/13 cm

questions.question: Abhi bought two articles for Rs. 624. He sold one at a loss of 14% and the other at a profit of 14%. If the selling price of both the articles is equal, then the difference between their cost prices (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
Let the cost of each article be 50x.

SP of the first article = 50x × [114/100]

SP of the second article = 50x × [86/100] = 43x

Ratio of CP and SP of the first article = 50x : 57x

Ratio of CP and SP of the second article = 50x : 43x

Multiply by 43 in equation (1) and multiply by 57 in equation (2)

New ratio of CP and SP of the first article = 2850x : 2451x

New ratio of CP and SP of the second article = 2150x : 2451x

According to the question

⇒ 2850x + 2150x = 624

⇒ 5000x = 624

⇒ 700x = [624/5000] × 700 = 87.36
